   real(dp) :: x(101)

! Solve x**2 - 2 = 0 with Brent's method.
! Module callbacks avoid executable-stack trampolines for internal procedures.
module audit_functions
   use iso_fortran_env, only: wp => real64
   use root_module, only: root_solver
   implicit none
contains
   function equation(me, x) result(y)
      class(root_solver), intent(inout) :: me
      real(wp), intent(in) :: x
      real(wp) :: y
      y = x*x - 2.0_wp
   end function equation
end module audit_functions

program demo
   use iso_fortran_env, only: wp => real64
   use root_module, only: brent_solver
   use audit_functions, only: equation
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   real(wp) :: x, residual
   integer :: status
   type(brent_solver) :: solver
   call solver%initialize(equation, rtol=1.0e-12_wp)
   call solver%solve(0.0_wp, 2.0_wp, x, residual, status)
   if (.not. ieee_is_finite(x)) error stop 'nonfinite root'
   if (status /= 0 .or. abs(x - sqrt(2.0_wp)) > 1.0e-9_wp) error stop 'incorrect root'
   print '(a,f15.12)', 'PASS roots-fortran sqrt(2)=', x
end program demo

source:
! Interpolate linear data and verify an interior value.
program demo
   use iso_fortran_env, only: wp => real64
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use pchip_module, only: dpchim, dpchfe
   implicit none
   real(wp) :: x(3), f(1,3), d(1,3), query(1), answer(1)
   integer :: status
   logical :: skip
   x = [0.0_wp, 1.0_wp, 2.0_wp]
   f(1,:) = 2*x + 1
   call dpchim(3, x, f, d, 1, status)
   if (status < 0) error stop 'derivative calculation failed'
   skip = .false.
   query = 0.5_wp
   call dpchfe(3, x, f, d, 1, skip, 1, query, answer, status)
   if (.not. ieee_is_finite(answer(1))) error stop 'nonfinite interpolation'
   if (status < 0 .or. abs(answer(1) - 2.0_wp) > 1.0e-12_wp) error stop 'incorrect interpolation'
   print '(a,f8.4)', 'PASS pchip value=', answer(1)
end program demo

source:
module ode_functions
   use dop853_module, only: dop853_class, wp => dop853_wp
   implicit none
contains
   subroutine decay(me, x, y, derivative)
      class(dop853_class), intent(inout) :: me
      real(wp), intent(in) :: x, y(:)
      real(wp), intent(out) :: derivative(:)
      derivative = -y
   end subroutine
end module
program main
   use ode_functions
   implicit none
   type(dop853_class) :: solver
   real(wp) :: x, y(1)
   integer :: status
   logical :: initialized
   x = 0.0_wp
   y = 1.0_wp
   call solver%initialize(n=1, fcn=decay, status_ok=initialized)
   if (.not. initialized) error stop 'initialization failed'
   call solver%integrate(x, y, 1.0_wp, [1.e-10_wp], [1.e-10_wp], 0, status)
   if (status < 0 .or. abs(y(1)-exp(-1.0_wp)) > 1.e-8_wp) error stop 'incorrect ODE solution'
   print *, 'y(1) for dy/dx=-y:', y
   print *, 'PASS dop853'
end program main

description: Nonlinear equation solvers and nonlinear least-squares fitting.
source:
module equations
   use minpack_module, only: wp
   implicit none
contains
   subroutine residual(n, x, fvec, iflag)
      integer, intent(in) :: n
      real(wp), intent(in) :: x(n)
      real(wp), intent(out) :: fvec(n)
      integer, intent(inout) :: iflag
      fvec = [x(1)**2-2.0_wp, x(2)-3.0_wp]
   end subroutine
end module
program main
   use minpack_module, only: hybrd1
   use equations
   implicit none
   real(wp) :: x(2), fvec(2), work(19)
   integer :: status
   x = [1.0_wp,1.0_wp]
   call hybrd1(residual, 2, x, fvec, 1.e-10_wp, status, work, size(work))
   if (status /= 1 .or. maxval(abs(fvec)) > 1.e-8_wp) error stop 'nonlinear solve failed'
   print *, 'Solution (sqrt(2), 3):', x
   print *, 'PASS minpack'
end program main

program main
   use lbfgsb_module, only: setulb, wp => lbfgsp_wp
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: n=2, m=5
   real(wp) :: x(n), lower(n), upper(n), f, g(n), wa(2*m*n+5*n+11*m*m+8*m), dsave(29)
   integer :: bounds(n), iwa(3*n), isave(44), iteration
   logical :: lsave(4)
   character(60) :: task, csave
   x = 0.0_wp
   lower = -1.0_wp
   upper = 1.0_wp
   bounds = 2
   task = 'START'
   ! The unconstrained minimum is (2,2); the bounded minimum is (1,1).
   do iteration = 1, 100
      call setulb(n,m,x,lower,upper,bounds,f,g,1.e7_wp,1.e-8_wp, &
         wa,iwa,task,-1,csave,lsave,isave,dsave)
      if (task(1:2) == 'FG') then
         f = sum((x-2.0_wp)**2)
         g = 2*(x-2.0_wp)
      else if (task(1:5) /= 'NEW_X') then
         exit
      end if
   end do
   if (task(1:4) /= 'CONV' .or. maxval(abs(x-1.0_wp)) > 1.e-8_wp) error stop 'incorrect optimum'
   print *, 'Bounded minimum at:', x
   print *, 'PASS lbfgsb'
end program

   data(:,1) = [-2.0_rk,-1.0_rk,0.0_rk,1.0_rk,2.0_rk]

program main

   integer, parameter :: degree=3
   real(wp) :: coefficients(4)=[1._wp,-6._wp,11._wp,-6._wp]
   real(wp) :: re(degree), im(degree), residual, expected
   complex(wp) :: z, value
   integer :: status, i, j
   ! x**3 - 6*x**2 + 11*x - 6 has roots 1, 2, 3.
   call polyroots(degree,coefficients,re,im,status)
   if (status /= 0) error stop 'root solver failed'
   do i=1,degree
      z=cmplx(re(i),im(i),kind=wp); value=cmplx(coefficients(1),0._wp,kind=wp)
      do j=2,degree+1
         value=value*z+coefficients(j)
      end do
      residual=abs(value)
      if (residual > 1.e-10_wp) error stop 'large polynomial residual'
      print *, 'Root and residual:',z,residual
   end do
   do j=1,3
      expected=real(j,wp)
      if (minval(abs(cmplx(re,im,kind=wp)-expected)) > 1.e-10_wp) error stop 'missing root'
   end do
   print *, 'PASS polyroots-fortran'
end program main

   if (rc /= SQLITE_DONE) error stop 'unexpected additional row'
   rc=sqlite3_finalize(statement)
   if (rc /= SQLITE_OK) error stop 'cannot finalize query'

   real(wp) :: distance, azimuth1, azimuth2, arc, reduced, scale12, scale21, area
   real(wp) :: latitude, longitude, final_bearing
   ! Equatorial quarter-circle: distance must equal pi*a/2.
   call inverse(a,f,0._wp,0._wp,0._wp,90._wp,distance,azimuth1,azimuth2, &
      0,arc,reduced,scale12,scale21,area)

      distance,azimuth1,azimuth2,0,arc,reduced,scale12,scale21,area)
   if (distance < 5.58e6_wp .or. distance > 5.59e6_wp) error stop 'incorrect city distance'
   call direct(a,f,51.5074_wp,-0.1278_wp,azimuth1,distance,0,latitude,longitude, &
      final_bearing,0,arc,reduced,scale12,scale21,area)
   if (abs(latitude-40.7128_wp)>1.e-8_wp .or. abs(longitude+74.0060_wp)>1.e-8_wp) &
      error stop 'failed geodesic round trip'

module objective_module

      class(simulated_annealing_type), intent(inout) :: me
      real(dp), intent(in) :: x(:)
      real(dp), intent(out) :: value
      integer, intent(out) :: status
      ! Rastrigin function: global minimum is zero at (0,0).
      value=sum(x*x+10._dp*(1._dp-cos(2*acos(-1._dp)*x)))
      status=0
   end subroutine objective

      .false.,1.e-8_dp,20,10,4,200000,0,1,2,1,0.1_dp,output_unit)

module line_model

   use iso_c_binding, only: c_ptr
   implicit none
contains
   pure subroutine line(n,m,q,np,ldifx,beta,xplusd,ifixb,ifixx,ideval,f,fjacb,fjacd,istop,data)
      integer, intent(in) :: n,m,q,np,ldifx,ideval,ifixb(np),ifixx(ldifx,m)
      real(dp), intent(in) :: beta(np),xplusd(n,m)
      real(dp), intent(out) :: f(n,q),fjacb(n,np,q),fjacd(n,m,q)
      integer, intent(out) :: istop
      type(c_ptr), value, intent(in) :: data
      istop=0
      if (mod(ideval,10)>0) f(:,1)=beta(1)+beta(2)*xplusd(:,1)
      if (mod(ideval/10,10)>0) then
         fjacb(:,1,1)=1._dp
         fjacb(:,2,1)=xplusd(:,1)
      end if
      if (mod(ideval/100,10)>0) fjacd(:,1,1)=beta(2)
   end subroutine line
end module line_model

program main
   use line_model
   use odrpack, only: odr,odrpack_model
   implicit none
   type(odrpack_model) :: model
   real(dp) :: x(6,1),y(6,1),beta(2),xc(6),yc(6),sxx,syy,sxy,slope,intercept
   integer :: info,i
   x(:,1)=[(real(i,dp),i=0,5)]
   y(:,1)=[1.1_dp,2.9_dp,5.1_dp,6.9_dp,9.1_dp,10.9_dp]
   beta=[0._dp,1._dp]
   model%fcn=>line
   ! Orthogonal distance regression treats errors in both x and y.
   call odr(model,6,1,1,2,beta,y,x,job=20,iprint=0,info=info)
   xc=x(:,1)-sum(x(:,1))/6
   yc=y(:,1)-sum(y(:,1))/6
   sxx=sum(xc**2); syy=sum(yc**2); sxy=sum(xc*yc)
   slope=(syy-sxx+sqrt((syy-sxx)**2+4*sxy**2))/(2*sxy)
   intercept=sum(y(:,1))/6-slope*sum(x(:,1))/6
   if (info<1.or.info>3) error stop 'ODR convergence failed'
   if (maxval(abs(beta-[intercept,slope]))>1e-5_dp) error stop 'ODR differs from analytic TLS'
   print '(a,2f12.6)', 'Intercept and slope:',beta
   print '(a,f12.6)', 'Maximum vertical residual:',maxval(abs(y(:,1)-beta(1)-beta(2)*x(:,1)))
   print *, 'PASS odrpack95'
end program main

      real(wp), optional, intent(in) :: params(:)

program main
   use decay_model
   implicit none
   type(decay_system), target :: equation
   type(ERK_class) :: solver
   real(wp) :: finish,y(1),step,times(5),values(1,5)
   integer :: i
   equation%n=1; equation%m=0
   ! Keep the dense solution, then sample it without integrating again.
   call solver%Init(equation,1000,ATol=[1e-11_wp],RTol=[1e-11_wp],InterpOn=.true.)
   if (solver%status/=FLINT_SUCCESS) error stop 'Initialization failed'
   finish=2._wp

   if (solver%status/=FLINT_SUCCESS) error stop 'Integration failed'
   times=[(real(i-1,wp)*.5_wp,i=1,5)]
   call solver%Interpolate(times,values)
   if (solver%status/=FLINT_SUCCESS) error stop 'Interpolation failed'
   if (abs(y(1)-exp(-finish))>1e-9_wp) error stop
   if (maxval(abs(values(1,:)-exp(-times)))>1e-9_wp) error stop
   print '(a)', '    Time     Dense solution       exp(-t)'

module sparse_operator
   use iso_fortran_env, only: dp=>real64
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: row(7)=[1,2,3,2,3,1,2],col(7)=[1,2,3,1,2,2,3]
   real(dp), parameter :: entries(7)=[3._dp,2._dp,1._dp,4._dp,2._dp,4._dp,2._dp]
contains
   subroutine aprod(n,x,y)
      integer, intent(in) :: n
      real(dp), intent(in) :: x(n)
      real(dp), intent(out) :: y(n)
      integer :: i
      y=0._dp
      do i=1,size(entries)
         y(row(i))=y(row(i))+entries(i)*x(col(i))
      end do
   end subroutine
   subroutine msolve(n,x,y)
      integer, intent(in) :: n
      real(dp), intent(in) :: x(n)
      real(dp), intent(out) :: y(n)
      y=x
   end subroutine
end module
program main

   use minres, only: minres_solver
   implicit none
   real(dp) :: b(3),x(3),ax(3),anorm,acond,rnorm,arnorm,ynorm,residual
   integer :: istop,itn
   call aprod(3,[1._dp,2._dp,3._dp],b)
   ! Module callbacks avoid the internal-procedure closures in minres_ez_t.
   call minres_solver(3,aprod,msolve,b,0._dp,.true.,.false.,x,100,0,1e-12_dp, &
      istop,itn,anorm,acond,rnorm,arnorm,ynorm)
   call aprod(3,x,ax)
   residual=maxval(abs(ax-b))
   if (residual>1e-9_dp.or.maxval(abs(x-[1._dp,2._dp,3._dp]))>1e-9_dp) error stop
   print '(a,3f12.7)', 'Solution:',x

program demo_metis
   use iso_c_binding, only: c_int
   use metis_c_interface
   implicit none
   integer(idx_t) :: xadj(10), adjncy(24), weights(24), options(0:METIS_NOPTIONS-1)
   integer(idx_t) :: part(9), edgecut, nvtxs, ncon, nparts
   integer(c_int) :: status
   integer :: row, col, vertex, next, other, cuts, i

   ! Undirected 3-by-3 grid graph, with zero-based vertex numbers for METIS.
   next = 1
   do row = 0, 2
      do col = 0, 2
         vertex = 3*row + col
         xadj(vertex+1) = int(next-1, idx_t)
         if (row > 0) then
            adjncy(next) = int(vertex-3, idx_t); next = next+1
         end if
         if (row < 2) then
            adjncy(next) = int(vertex+3, idx_t); next = next+1
         end if
         if (col > 0) then
            adjncy(next) = int(vertex-1, idx_t); next = next+1
         end if
         if (col < 2) then
            adjncy(next) = int(vertex+1, idx_t); next = next+1
         end if
      end do
   end do
   xadj(10) = int(next-1, idx_t)
   weights = 1_idx_t
   nvtxs = 9_idx_t; ncon = 1_idx_t; nparts = 2_idx_t
   status = METIS_SetDefaultOptions(options)
   if (status /= METIS_OK) error stop 'METIS default options failed'
   options(METIS_OPTION_SEED) = 42_idx_t
   status = METIS_PartGraphRecursive(nvtxs, ncon, xadj, adjncy, adjwgt=weights, &
      nparts=nparts, options=options, edgecut=edgecut, part=part)
   if (status /= METIS_OK) error stop 'METIS partition failed'
   if (any(part < 0_idx_t) .or. any(part >= nparts)) error stop 'Invalid partition'
   if (count(part == 0) < 3 .or. count(part == 1) < 3) error stop 'Unbalanced partition'
   cuts = 0
   do vertex = 1, 9
      do i = int(xadj(vertex))+1, int(xadj(vertex+1))
         other = int(adjncy(i))+1
         if (part(vertex) /= part(other)) cuts = cuts+1
      end do
   end do
   if (cuts/2 /= edgecut) error stop 'Edge cut check failed'
   print '(a,2i4)', 'Partition sizes:', count(part == 0), count(part == 1)
   print '(a,i4)', 'Edges crossing partitions:', edgecut
   do row = 0, 2
      print '(3i4)', part(3*row+1:3*row+3)
   end do
   print *, 'PASS metis-fpm'
end program demo_metis

   call lu_factor(a, ipvt=pivots, lu=lu)
   x = solve_lu(lu, pivots, b)
   if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite(x))) error stop 'Nonfinite solution'
   if (maxval(abs(x-[1._real64, 2._real64, 3._real64])) > 1.e-12_real64) error stop 'Incorrect solution'
   if (maxval(abs(matmul(a,x)-b)) > 1.e-12_real64) error stop 'Linear-system residual'
   print '(a,3f12.6)', 'Solution:', x

   symmetric = reshape([2._real64, 1._real64, 1._real64, 2._real64], [2,2])
   call eigen(symmetric, values, vectors)
   if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite(values))) error stop 'Nonfinite eigenvalues'
   if (maxval(abs(values-[1._real64, 3._real64])) > 1.e-12_real64) error stop 'Incorrect eigenvalues'
   if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite(vectors))) error stop 'Nonfinite eigenvectors'
   do i = 1, 2
      if (maxval(abs(matmul(symmetric,vectors(:,i))-values(i)*vectors(:,i))) > 1.e-12_real64) &
         error stop 'Eigenvector residual'
   end do
   print '(a,2f12.6)', 'Eigenvalues:', values
   print *, 'PASS linalg'
end program demo_linalg

program demo_pcre2
   use pcre2
   implicit none(type, external)
   character(*), parameter :: pattern = '(?<year>[0-9]{4})-(?<month>[0-9]{2})-(?<day>[0-9]{2})'
   character(*), parameter :: subject = 'Observation date: 2026-10-27'
   type(c_ptr) :: regex, matches, pointer
   integer :: error_code, status
   integer(pcre2_size) :: error_offset
   integer(pcre2_size), pointer :: offsets(:)
   character(4) :: year
   character(2) :: month, day

   regex = pcre2_compile(pattern, len(pattern,kind=pcre2_size), 0, error_code, error_offset, c_null_ptr)
   if (.not. c_associated(regex)) error stop 'Regular-expression compilation failed'
   matches = pcre2_match_data_create(4, c_null_ptr)
   if (.not. c_associated(matches)) error stop 'Match-data allocation failed'
   status = pcre2_match(regex, subject, len(subject,kind=pcre2_size), &
      0_pcre2_size, 0, matches, c_null_ptr)
   if (status /= 4) error stop 'Expected complete match and three capture groups'
   pointer = pcre2_get_ovector_pointer(matches)
   if (.not. c_associated(pointer)) error stop 'Missing capture offsets'
   call c_f_pointer(pointer, offsets, [8])
   if (any(offsets > len(subject))) error stop 'Capture outside subject'
   year = subject(offsets(3)+1:offsets(4))
   month = subject(offsets(5)+1:offsets(6))
   day = subject(offsets(7)+1:offsets(8))
   if (year /= '2026' .or. month /= '10' .or. day /= '27') error stop 'Incorrect captured date'
   print '(a)', subject
   print '(a)', 'Captured year='//year//', month='//month//', day='//day
   status = pcre2_match(regex, 'No date here', 12_pcre2_size, 0_pcre2_size, 0, matches, c_null_ptr)
   if (status /= PCRE2_ERROR_NOMATCH) error stop 'Expected no match'
   call pcre2_match_data_free(matches)
   call pcre2_code_free(regex)
   print *, 'PASS fortran-pcre2'
end program demo_pcre2

   implicit none
   type(runge_kutta_45) :: solver
   type(ode_container) :: model
   real(dp), allocatable :: solution(:,:), exact(:)
   real(dp) :: frequency, error
   integer :: n
   model%fcn => rhs
   call solver%set_absolute_tolerance(1.e-10_dp)
   call solver%set_relative_tolerance(1.e-10_dp)
   call solver%solve(model,[0.0_dp,10.0_dp],[1.0_dp,0.0_dp])
   solution = solver%get_solution()
   n = size(solution,1)
   if (n<2) error stop 'No solution'
   if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite(solution))) error stop 'Nonfinite solution'
   if (abs(solution(n,1)-10.0_dp)>1.e-9_dp) error stop 'Incomplete integration'
   frequency = sqrt(0.99_dp)
   exact = exp(-0.1_dp*solution(:,1)) * &
      (cos(frequency*solution(:,1))+0.1_dp/frequency*sin(frequency*solution(:,1)))
   error = maxval(abs(solution(:,2)-exact))
   print '(a,i0)', 'Adaptive solution points: ', n
   print '(a,f12.8)', 'Displacement at time 10: ', solution(n,2)
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum error against analytic solution: ', error

program constrained_quadratic
   use conmin_module, only: conmin_class, wp => conmin_wp
   use, intrinsic :: ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: n1=4, n2=5, n3=5, n4=5, n5=10
   type(conmin_class) :: solver
   real(wp) :: x(n1), lower(n1), upper(n1), g(n2), scal(n1), df(n1), a(n1,n3)
   real(wp) :: s(n1), g1(n2), g2(n2), b(n3,n3), c(n4), value
   integer :: isc(n2), ic(n3), ms1(n5), i
   ! Minimize x**2+y**2 subject to x+y >= 1. Exact optimum: (0.5,0.5).
   x=1; lower=-10; upper=10; scal=1
   g=0; df=0; a=0; s=0; g1=0; g2=0; b=0; c=0; isc=0; ic=0; ms1=0
   solver%ndv=2; solver%ncon=1; solver%nside=1
   solver%infog=0; solver%info=0; solver%nfdg=0; solver%iprint=0
   solver%itmax=100; solver%icndir=0; solver%nscal=0; solver%itrm=3
   solver%ct=-1.e-6_wp; solver%ctmin=1.e-7_wp
   solver%delfun=1.e-10_wp; solver%dabfun=1.e-10_wp
   solver%igoto=0
   do i=1,1000
      call solver%solve(x,lower,upper,g,scal,df,a,s,g1,g2,b,c,isc,ic,ms1,n1,n2,n3,n4,n5)
      solver%obj=sum(x(1:2)**2)
      g(1)=1-x(1)-x(2)
      if (solver%igoto==0) exit
   end do
   value=sum(x(1:2)**2)
   print '(a,2f12.6)', 'Constrained minimum at: ', x(1:2)
   print '(a,f12.6)', 'Objective (expected 0.5): ', value
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Constraint violation: ', max(0.0_wp,g(1))
   if (solver%igoto/=0) error stop 'Iteration limit'
   if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite(x(1:2)))) error stop 'Nonfinite result'
   if (maxval(abs(x(1:2)-0.5_wp))>1.e-3_wp .or. g(1)>1.e-4_wp) error stop 'Optimum check'
   print *, 'PASS conmin'
end program

program huffman_round_trip
   use huffman_mod, only: hftree
   implicit none
   character(*), parameter :: text = repeat('Fortran compresses repeated text. ',100)
   character(len(text)) :: restored
   integer :: unit, original_size, compressed_size, restored_size
   open(newunit=unit,file='message.txt',status='replace',access='stream',form='unformatted')
   write(unit) text
   close(unit)
   block
      type(hftree) :: encoder
      call encoder%encode('message.txt')
   end block
   block
      type(hftree) :: decoder
      call decoder%decode('message.txt.bin')
   end block
   inquire(file='message.txt',size=original_size)
   inquire(file='message.txt.bin',size=compressed_size)
   inquire(file='message.txt.bin.txt',size=restored_size)
   if (restored_size/=len(text)) error stop 'Length mismatch'
   open(newunit=unit,file='message.txt.bin.txt',access='stream',form='unformatted',status='old')
   read(unit) restored
   close(unit)
   if (restored/=text) error stop 'Round-trip mismatch'
   print '(a,i0)', 'Original bytes: ', original_size
   print '(a,i0)', 'Compressed bytes (including tree): ', compressed_size
   print '(a)', 'Decoded text matches every original byte.'
   print *, 'PASS fortran_huffman'
end program

   use fast_rsqrt, only: frsqrt
   use, intrinsic :: ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   real(dp) :: x(101), positive(101), exp_value(101), log_value(101), rsqrt_value(101)
   real(dp) :: exp_error, log_error, rsqrt_error
   integer :: i
   x = [(-3.0_dp+6.0_dp*i/100,i=0,100)]
   positive = exp(x)
   exp_value = fexp(x)
   log_value = flog_quintic(positive)
   rsqrt_value = frsqrt(positive)
   if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite(exp_value))) error stop 'Nonfinite exponential'
   if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite(log_value))) error stop 'Nonfinite logarithm'
   if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite(rsqrt_value))) error stop 'Nonfinite inverse square root'
   exp_error = maxval(abs(exp_value/exp(x)-1))
   log_error = maxval(abs(log_value-x))
   rsqrt_error = maxval(abs(rsqrt_value*sqrt(positive)-1))
   print '(a)', 'Approximation errors on 101 points, x in [-3,3], positive arguments exp(x):'
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'exp: maximum relative error = ', exp_error
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'log (quintic): maximum absolute error = ', log_error
   print '(a,es12.4)', '1/sqrt: maximum relative error = ', rsqrt_error
   if (exp_error>1.e-4_dp .or. log_error>1.e-3_dp .or. rsqrt_error>2.e-3_dp) error stop 'Accuracy check'

program time_series_correlations

   use fortsa_stats_m, only: acvf, acvf_opt, acvf2acf
   use, intrinsic :: ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   integer(c_int), parameter :: n=64, m=9
   real(c_double) :: series(n), centered(n), covariance(m), fft_covariance(m), reference(m)
   integer :: i, lag
   series = [(sin(2*acos(-1.0_c_double)*i/16)+0.3_c_double*cos(2*acos(-1.0_c_double)*i/8),i=0,n-1)]
   centered = series-sum(series)/n
   do lag=0,m-1
      reference(lag+1) = sum(centered(1:n-lag)*centered(1+lag:n))/n
   end do
   call acvf(series,n,covariance,m)
   call acvf_opt(series,n,1_c_int,fft_covariance,m)
   if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite(covariance))) error stop 'Nonfinite covariance'
   if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite(fft_covariance))) error stop 'Nonfinite FFT covariance'
   if (maxval(abs(covariance-reference))>1.e-10_c_double) error stop 'Direct covariance check'
   if (maxval(abs(fft_covariance-reference))>1.e-10_c_double) error stop 'FFT covariance check'
   call acvf2acf(covariance,m)
   if (maxval(abs(covariance-reference/reference(1)))>1.e-10_c_double) error stop 'Correlation check'
   print '(a)', 'Autocorrelation of a generated periodic time series:'
   print '(a)', '  Lag   Correlation'

   use flann, only: flann_index, KDTreeSingleIndexParams, search_params
   use, intrinsic :: ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: n=25, nq=3
   real(c_float), target :: points(2,n)
   real(c_float) :: queries(2,nq), distances(1,nq), direct(n)
   integer(c_int) :: indices(1,nq), status
   type(flann_index) :: tree
   integer :: i,j,k,expected
   k=0
   do j=0,4
      do i=0,4
         k=k+1
         points(:,k) = real([i,j],c_float)
      end do
   end do
   queries = reshape([0.1_c_float,0.2_c_float,2.8_c_float,1.1_c_float,3.9_c_float,3.8_c_float],[2,nq])
   tree = flann_index(points,KDTreeSingleIndexParams(),'Euclidean')
   call tree%build_index()
   indices = -1
   distances = -1
   call tree%knn_search(queries,indices,distances,1_c_int,search_params(checks=-1),stat=status)
   if (status/=0) error stop 'Nearest-neighbor search failed'
   if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite(distances))) error stop 'Nonfinite distance'
   print '(a)', ' Query point        Nearest point       Squared distance'
   do j=1,nq
      direct = [(sum((points(:,i)-queries(:,j))**2),i=1,n)]
      expected = minloc(direct,dim=1)
      ! FLANN returns C-style indices, starting at zero.
      if (indices(1,j)+1/=expected) error stop 'Neighbor index check'
      if (abs(distances(1,j)-direct(expected))>1.e-5_c_float) error stop 'Distance check'
      print '(2f7.2,4x,2f7.2,4x,f12.6)', queries(:,j),points(:,expected),distances(1,j)

end program

program stiff_reactions

   use, intrinsic :: ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   type(lsoda_class) :: solver
   real(dp) :: y(3), t, tout, atol(1)
   real(dp), parameter :: targets(5) = [0.4_dp,4.0_dp,40.0_dp,400.0_dp,4000.0_dp]
   integer :: state, i
   call solver%initialize(robertson,3,istate=state)
   if (state<0) error stop 'Solver initialization'
   y = [1.0_dp,0.0_dp,0.0_dp]
   t = 0
   atol = 1.e-12_dp
   state = 1
   print '(a)', '          Time             A             B             C'
   do i=1,size(targets)
      tout = targets(i)
      call solver%integrate(y,t,tout,1.e-8_dp,atol,1,state)
      if (state<0) error stop 'Integration failed'
      if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite(y))) error stop 'Nonfinite concentration'
      if (abs(t-tout)>1.e-7_dp .or. abs(sum(y)-1)>1.e-7_dp) error stop 'Conservation check'
      if (minval(y)<-1.e-10_dp) error stop 'Negative concentration'
      print '(4es14.5)', t,y
   end do

   if (maxval(abs(y-[0.183202_dp,8.94237e-7_dp,0.816797_dp]))>3.e-6_dp) error stop 'Reference check'
   print '(a)', 'Total concentration remains 1; final state agrees with the reference.'

program conjugate_gradient

   use, intrinsic :: ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: n = 8
   real(wp) :: a(n,n), b(n), x(n), exact(n), residual
   integer :: i, info

   do i=1,n
      a(i,i) = 2
      if (i<n) then
         a(i,i+1) = -1
         a(i+1,i) = -1

module playground_psqp_functions
   use psqp_module, only: psqp_class,wp => psqp_wp
   implicit none
contains
    subroutine obj(me,nf,x,ff)

        !! user supplied subroutine (calculation of ff)

        class(psqp_class),intent(inout) :: me
        real(wp) :: ff
        integer  :: nf
        real(wp) :: x(nf)

        ff = x(1)**2 + x(2)**2 + x(3)  !objective function

    end subroutine obj

    subroutine dobj(me,nf,x,gf)

        !! user supplied subroutine (calculation of gf)

        class(psqp_class),intent(inout) :: me
        integer  :: nf
        real(wp) :: gf(nf),x(nf)

        gf(1) = 2.0_wp*x(1)
        gf(2) = 2.0_wp*x(2)
        gf(3) = 1.0_wp

    end subroutine dobj

    subroutine con(me,nf,kc,x,fc)

        !! user supplied subroutine (calculation of fc)

        class(psqp_class),intent(inout) :: me
        real(wp) :: fc
        integer  :: kc,nf
        real(wp) :: x(nf)

        select case (kc)
        case(1)
            fc = x(1)*x(2) - x(3)       !equality constraint (==0)
        case(2)
            fc = x(3) - 1.0_wp          !inequality constraint (>=0)
        case default
            error stop 'invalid kc'
        end select

    end subroutine con

    subroutine dcon(me,nf,kc,x,gc)

        !! user supplied subroutine (calculation of gc)

        class(psqp_class),intent(inout) :: me
        integer  :: kc,nf
        real(wp) :: gc(nf),x(nf)

        select case (kc)
        case(1)
            gc(1) = x(2)
            gc(2) = x(1)
            gc(3) = -1.0_wp
        case(2)
            gc(1) = 0.0_wp
            gc(2) = 0.0_wp
            gc(3) = 1.0_wp
        case default
            error stop 'invalid kc'
        end select

    end subroutine dcon

end module

! Minimize x1**2+x2**2+x3 with x1*x2=x3 and x3>=1.
! The minimum is 3 at (1,1,1) or (-1,-1,1).
program demo_psqp
   use playground_psqp_functions
   use, intrinsic :: ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   type(psqp_class) :: solver
   real(wp) :: x(3),xl(3),xu(3),cf(3),cl(2),cu(2),rpar(5),f,cmax,gmax
   integer :: ix(3),ic(2),ipar(6),status
   x = [1.0_wp,2.0_wp,3.0_wp]
   xl = -10; xu = 10; ix = 3
   ic = [5,1]; cl = 0; cu = 0
   ipar = [500,1000,0,0,1,1]
   rpar = [0.0_wp,1e-10_wp,1e-10_wp,1e-8_wp,0.0_wp]
   call solver%psqpn(3,1,2,x,ix,xl,xu,cf,ic,cl,cu,ipar,rpar,f,cmax,gmax,0,status,obj,dobj,con,dcon)
   if (status<=0) error stop 'Optimization failed'

   if (maxval(abs(abs(x)-1.0_wp))>1e-5_wp .or. x(3)<0) error stop 'Known optimum differs'

! A rank-one matrix needs an explicit singular-value cutoff in this API.
program demo_forinv
   use kinds, only: rk
   use forinv, only: inv
   use, intrinsic :: ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   real(rk) :: a(3,2),workspace(3,2),pinv(2,3),b(3),x(2),left(3,3),right(2,2),errors(4)
   integer :: i
   a(:,1) = [1.0_rk,2.0_rk,3.0_rk]
   a(:,2) = 2*a(:,1)
   b = a(:,1)
   ! The pinned ForSVD passes its input to LAPACK workspace despite INTENT(IN).
   ! Preserve the original matrix explicitly for residuals and later use.
   workspace = a
   pinv = inv(workspace,tol=1e-10_rk)
   if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite(pinv))) error stop 'Nonfinite pseudoinverse'
   left = matmul(a,pinv); right = matmul(pinv,a)
   errors = [maxval(abs(matmul(left,a)-a)),maxval(abs(matmul(right,pinv)-pinv)), &
      maxval(abs(transpose(left)-left)),maxval(abs(transpose(right)-right))]
   if (any(errors>1e-11_rk)) error stop 'Moore-Penrose identities fail'
   x = matmul(pinv,b)
   ! All solutions satisfy x1+2*x2=1; the minimum-norm one is (1/5,2/5).
   if (maxval(abs(x-[0.2_rk,0.4_rk]))>1e-11_rk) error stop 'Wrong minimum-norm solution'
   if (maxval(abs(matmul(a,x)-b))>1e-11_rk) error stop 'Residual too large'
   print '(a)', 'Pseudoinverse of a rank-deficient 3 by 2 matrix:'
   do i=1,2
      print '(3f14.8)',pinv(i,:)
   end do
   print '(a,2f14.8)', 'Minimum-norm solution: ',x
   print '(a,4es12.3)', 'Four Moore-Penrose identity errors: ',errors
   print '(a)', 'PASS forinv'
end program

! Factor one sparse tridiagonal matrix, then solve two right-hand sides.
program demo_y12m
   use y12m, only: y12mb,y12mc,y12md
   use iso_fortran_env, only: wp => real64
   use, intrinsic :: ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: n=8,nn=500
   real(wp) :: a(nn),pivot(n),b(n),original_rhs(n),flags(8),matrix(n,n),exact(n),residual
   integer :: columns(nn),rows(nn),ha(n,11),iflag(10),status,nz,i,j,load
   matrix = 0; a = 0; rows = 0; columns = 0; ha = 0; nz = 0
   do i=1,n
      matrix(i,i) = 3
      if (i<n) then
         matrix(i,i+1) = -1
         matrix(i+1,i) = -1
      end if
   end do
   do i=1,n
      do j=1,n
         if (matrix(i,j)==0) cycle
         nz = nz+1; a(nz) = matrix(i,j); rows(nz) = i; columns(nz) = j
      end do
   end do
   iflag = 0; flags = 0
   iflag(2:5) = [3,1,0,2] ! Keep L for subsequent right-hand sides.
   flags(1:4) = [16.0_wp,1e-12_wp,1e16_wp,1e-12_wp]
   exact = 1; b = matmul(matrix,exact)
   call y12mb(n,nz,a,columns,nn,rows,nn,ha,n,flags,iflag,status)
   if (status/=0) error stop 'Sparse preparation failed'
   call y12mc(n,nz,a,columns,nn,rows,nn,pivot,b,ha,n,flags,iflag,status)
   if (status/=0) error stop 'Sparse factorization failed'
   do load=1,2
      if (load==2) then
         exact = [(real(i,wp),i=1,n)]
         b = matmul(matrix,exact)
         iflag(5) = 3 ! Full forward/back substitution using stored factors.
      end if
      original_rhs = matmul(matrix,exact)
      call y12md(n,a,nn,b,pivot,columns,ha,n,iflag,status)
      if (status/=0) error stop 'Sparse solve failed'
      if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite(b))) error stop 'Nonfinite solution'
      residual = maxval(abs(matmul(matrix,b)-original_rhs))
      if (residual>1e-10_wp .or. maxval(abs(b-exact))>1e-10_wp) error stop 'Sparse solution differs'
      print '(a,i0,a,8f8.3)', 'Right-hand side ',load,', solution: ',b
      print '(a,es12.3)', 'Maximum residual: ',residual
   end do
   print '(a)', 'One LU factorization used for both right-hand sides.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS y12m'
end program

! Three unit masses and four unit springs, with both ends fixed.
program demo_foreig
   use kinds, only: rk
   use foreig, only: eig
   use, intrinsic :: ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   real(rk) :: stiffness(3,3),workspace(3,3),identity(3,3),expected(3),residual,orthogonality
   real(rk), allocatable :: vectors(:,:),values(:)
   integer :: i
   stiffness = reshape([2.0_rk,-1.0_rk,0.0_rk,-1.0_rk,2.0_rk,-1.0_rk,0.0_rk,-1.0_rk,2.0_rk],[3,3])
   workspace = stiffness

   if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite(values))) error stop 'Nonfinite eigenvalues'
   if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite(vectors))) error stop 'Nonfinite eigenvectors'
   identity = 0
   do i=1,3
      identity(i,i) = 1
      expected(i) = 2.0_rk-2.0_rk*cos(real(i,rk)*acos(-1.0_rk)/4.0_rk)
      residual = norm2(matmul(stiffness,vectors(:,i))-values(i)*vectors(:,i))
      if (residual>1e-11_rk) error stop 'Eigenpair residual too large'
   end do
   orthogonality = maxval(abs(matmul(transpose(vectors),vectors)-identity))
   if (orthogonality>1e-11_rk) error stop 'Eigenvectors are not orthonormal'
   if (maxval(abs(values-expected))>1e-11_rk) error stop 'Analytic eigenvalues differ'
   print '(a)', 'Mode    Squared angular frequency    Angular frequency'
   do i=1,3
      print '(i3,2f25.12)',i,values(i),sqrt(values(i))
   end do
   print '(a,es12.3)', 'Orthogonality error: ',orthogonality
   print '(a)', 'PASS foreig'
end program

! Fit exact quadratic data using the rectangular-system solver.
program demo_forlab
   use forlab, only: RPRE,linspace,solve,vector_norm => norm
   use, intrinsic :: ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   real(RPRE) :: x(5),design(5,3),y(5),coefficients(3),residual
   ! The catalog fixes absent optional norm arguments before evaluating p.
   if (abs(vector_norm([3.0_RPRE,4.0_RPRE])-5.0_RPRE)>1e-6_RPRE) error stop 'Default norm differs'
   if (abs(vector_norm([3.0_RPRE,4.0_RPRE],1.0_RPRE)-7.0_RPRE)>1e-6_RPRE) error stop 'Explicit norm differs'
   if (abs(vector_norm(reshape([3.0_RPRE,0.0_RPRE,0.0_RPRE,4.0_RPRE],[2,2]))-4.0_RPRE)>1e-4_RPRE) &
      error stop 'Default matrix norm differs'
   if (abs(vector_norm(reshape([3.0_RPRE,0.0_RPRE,0.0_RPRE,4.0_RPRE],[2,2]),1)-4.0_RPRE)>1e-4_RPRE) &
      error stop 'Explicit matrix norm differs'
   x = linspace(-2.0_RPRE,2.0_RPRE,5)
   design(:,1) = 1; design(:,2) = x; design(:,3) = x*x
   y = 1.0_RPRE+2.0_RPRE*x-0.5_RPRE*x*x
   coefficients = solve(design,y)
   if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite(coefficients))) error stop 'Nonfinite fit coefficients'
   residual = maxval(abs(matmul(design,coefficients)-y))
   if (residual>1e-4_RPRE) error stop 'Fit residual too large'
   if (maxval(abs(coefficients-[1.0_RPRE,2.0_RPRE,-0.5_RPRE]))>1e-4_RPRE) error stop 'Wrong coefficients'
   print '(a,3f14.7)', 'Fitted constant, linear and quadratic coefficients: ',coefficients
   print '(a,es12.3)', 'Maximum residual: ',residual
   print '(a)', 'PASS forlab'
end program

module playground_dogleg_fit
   use iso_c_binding, only: wp => c_double
   implicit none
contains
   subroutine residual(x,f,jac,params)
      real(wp), intent(in) :: x(:)
      real(wp), intent(out) :: f(:),jac(:,:)
      class(*), intent(in), optional :: params
      real(wp) :: time,exponential,observed
      integer :: i
      do i=1,size(f)
         time = real(i-1,wp)/5
         exponential = exp(-x(2)*time)
         observed = 2.5_wp*exp(-0.7_wp*time)
         f(i) = x(1)*exponential-observed
         jac(1,i) = exponential
         jac(2,i) = -time*x(1)*exponential
      end do
   end subroutine
end module

program demo_dogleg
   use dogleg, only: dl_parameters2_t,dl_getDefaultParameters,dl_optimize
   use playground_dogleg_fit, only: wp,residual
   use, intrinsic :: ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   type(dl_parameters2_t) :: settings
   real(wp) :: x(2),objective,f(11),jac(2,11)
   x = [1.5_wp,0.3_wp]
   call dl_getDefaultParameters(settings)
   settings%max_iterations = 100
   settings%dogleg_debug = 0
   call dl_optimize(objective,x,11,residual,parameters=settings)
   if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite(x))) error stop 'Nonfinite fitted parameters'
   call residual(x,f,jac)
   if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite(f))) error stop 'Nonfinite residuals'
   if (maxval(abs(x-[2.5_wp,0.7_wp]))>1e-6_wp) error stop 'Known fit parameters differ'
   if (norm2(f)>1e-6_wp) error stop 'Fit residual too large'
   print '(a)', 'Fit amplitude*exp(-rate*t) to eleven exact observations.'
   print '(a,2f14.8)', 'Recovered amplitude and rate: ',x
   print '(a,es12.3)', 'Independently evaluated residual norm: ',norm2(f)
   print '(a)', 'PASS libdogleg-f'
end program

program demo_nafpack
   use NAFPack_kinds, only: sp
   use NAFPack_Fourier_Transform, only: Fourier_Transform,ALG_RADIX2_DIT,idft
   use, intrinsic :: ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: n=16
   type(Fourier_Transform) :: transform
   complex(sp) :: signal(n),expected(n),spectrum(n)
   complex(sp), allocatable :: recovered(:)
   real(sp) :: theta,real_part(n),imaginary_part(n),spectrum_error,roundtrip_error
   integer :: i
   do i=1,n
      theta = 2*acos(-1.0_sp)*real(i-1,sp)/n
      signal(i) = cmplx(cos(3*theta),sin(3*theta),sp)+0.25_sp*cmplx(cos(5*theta),sin(5*theta),sp)
   end do
   expected = cmplx(0.0_sp,0.0_sp,sp)
   expected(4) = real(n,sp); expected(6) = real(n,sp)/4
   call transform%create_fft_plan_sp(n,algorithm=ALG_RADIX2_DIT)
   call transform%execute_fft_plan_sp(real(signal,sp),aimag(signal),real_part,imaginary_part)
   spectrum = cmplx(real_part,imaginary_part,sp)
   call transform%destroy_fft_plan_sp()
   recovered = idft(spectrum)
   if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite(real(spectrum)))) error stop 'Nonfinite spectrum'
   if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite(aimag(spectrum)))) error stop 'Nonfinite spectrum'
   if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite(real(recovered)))) error stop 'Nonfinite reconstruction'
   if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite(aimag(recovered)))) error stop 'Nonfinite reconstruction'
   spectrum_error = maxval(abs(spectrum-expected))
   roundtrip_error = maxval(abs(recovered-signal))
   if (spectrum_error>1e-4_sp) error stop 'Known frequency amplitudes differ'
   if (roundtrip_error>1e-5_sp) error stop 'Inverse transform differs'
   print '(a)', 'Sixteen complex samples: frequency 3 plus frequency 5 at quarter amplitude.'
   print '(a)', 'Frequency   Fourier amplitude'
   do i=1,n
      if (abs(spectrum(i))>1e-4_sp) print '(i6,f20.8)',i-1,abs(spectrum(i))
   end do
   print '(a,es12.3)', 'Maximum spectral error: ',spectrum_error
   print '(a,es12.3)', 'Maximum round-trip error: ',roundtrip_error
   print '(a)', 'PASS nafpack'
end program
